stages.text: Kade Marsh is hailing you. Cycle target mode to SHIPS (T), target his patrol ship (] or click), then hail him back (H).
Get a feel for flying - turn (A/D or Left/Right) and thrust (W or Up) to move your ship.
Practice braking - hold S (or Down) to face opposite your velocity, then thrust to slow yourself down.
Target a ship and engage autopilot toward it (Space) - it'll fly you there and brake automatically.
Fly to the station or moon and land (L, once you're close and slow).
If you ever drift too far from the system center, open the Star Map (M), select this system, and jump back (J).
